blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The national government plans to develop housing on state-owned land in New Clark City, covering about 14 hectares, through a new partnership between the Pag-IBIG Fund and the Bases Conversion and Development Authority (BCDA). The partnership will form part of Pag-IBIG Fund’s Expanded Pambansang Pabahay para sa Pilipino (Expanded 4PH) Program. READ: Building PBBM’s housing legacy through Expanded 4PH Meanwhile, the state-run housing fund announced a partnership for a 10-hectare property in Bamban and 4 hectares in Capas, Tarlac. The plan includes developing housing on the former site and a government center on the latter, along with complementary […]...
